purpose: Separate search owners from non-index discovery filters while keeping a simple shopper-facing navigation.

discovery_roles.OWNER: Evidence-backed commercial landing. Still release-controlled and noindex until Human Owner approves exact Search Release.
discovery_roles.INTERSECTION_OWNER: Evidence-backed narrower landing whose intent is distinct from its parent.
discovery_roles.FILTER: UX refinement only. No standalone SEO ownership and no Search Release candidate while role=FILTER.

groups.purpose: Commercial event/occasion paths with proven query ownership
Performance-first path distinct from broad dance-recital intent
Non-index discovery filters until Q05/Q08 evidence proves a standalone owner

homepage.rule: Use a small set of strong evidence-backed gateways; do not expose every DNA value as a homepage SEO link.

landing_module_contract: FAQ only where current CQA-approved content supports it
technical_rules: All owner/navigation links are real Link/a href outputs.
Arbitrary filter combinations never become owner routes.
Root metadata remains fail-closed noindex; only ACTIVE immutable Search Release can opt approved paths into indexing.
Visual styling remains owner-reviewable and may change without changing discovery role or query ownership.
